public_rationale: This is an open-ended forecast with no deadline ('eventually'). By October 2026, agents had not gone away, but nothing shows they had become one of history's biggest time-savers. The best official measure found, from the St. Louis Fed, puts generative AI's time savings at 1.4% of all work hours in late 2024. That covers generative AI broadly, not agents. No decisive event settles the forecast either way.
limitations: The available time-savings data covers generative AI broadly, not agents.

public_payload.normalized_proposition: AI agents will not go away and will eventually be among the biggest time-savers humanity has known.

criteria.support_condition: Credible economy-wide measurements showing AI agents, still in wide use, save time on a scale comparable to history's major labor-saving technologies.
criteria.contradiction_condition: AI agents broadly abandoned, or, after a long period of mature, wide deployment, measured time savings stay small.
